description: Render an SVG document to a PNG at a chosen width, height or scale and background; external files, network references and XML entities are never loaded. Cost: 1 credit per call. File input (file): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: a file (image/png) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. The rendered PNG

file.description: Alternative to `svg`: an .svg or .svgz file as base64, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}

height.description: Output height in px (width follows the aspect ratio unless given)

scale.description: Multiplier of the SVG's own size (default 1); not combinable with width / height

svg.description: The SVG markup as text (up to 2 MB). Use `file` instead for a base64 / URL / uploaded .svg or .svgz

width.description: Output width in px (height follows the aspect ratio unless given)

name: svg_to_png
title: SVG to PNG renderer
